description: This Java class 'LocalizationTool' provides utilities for accessing resource bundles and formatting localized messages within a web application, specifically extending functionality for resource bundle loading and locale management.

classes.name: LocalizationTool
classes.description: A utility class extending ResourceTool for managing resource bundles and localization in the web application.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Overrides the base method to allow changing the locale used for resource bundle retrieval.

methods.name: getDefaultResourceBundle
methods.description: Returns the default English resource bundle, loading it if necessary.

methods.name: getBundle
methods.description: Retrieves the resource bundle for a given base name and locale, with fallback to default bundle if needed.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a localized message for a given code, providing the English message as fallback if translation is blank.
